gameDescriptionHtml:
Inner Voice is a first-person, exploration-driven adventure where you explore strange, dreamlike places, solve story puzzles and make choices that change what you learn. A mysterious voice, Magnus White, guides you and haunts you as you move through a dark world shaped by grief, memory and silence.

This is a slow-burning game. Take your time, look closely and put the story together at your own pace through hidden details, symbols and moments that don’t feel quite right.

Immerse yourself in a haunting world that mixes Victorian and Western themes. You’ll travel through abandoned spaces and surreal locations, following subtle clues that slowly reveal a bigger mystery.

You play as Booker, a man searching for answers after his wife’s disappearance. Along the way, Magnus speaks to you, guiding you, questioning you and revealing fragments of truth as the world unfolds around you. Magnus’ voice lies at the heart of the experience, shaping how the story is told. As you move forward, the voice becomes both a guide and a presence, driving the events that lead you toward your final chapter. Your choices affect how the story ends, leading to multiple endings, including a hidden secret ending for those willing to listen closely.

Game Features

  • Atmospheric Exploration – Every location, object and artwork helps reveal the bigger mystery.
  • Voice-Led Storytelling – A mysterious voice guides your journey through narration and voice-over.
  • Story Puzzles – Solve environmental puzzles by observing, understanding symbols and finding hidden clues.
  • Personal, Emotional Story – A story about loss and memory told through discovery, not action.
  • Multiple Endings – Your choices shape the path you take, including a secret ending for careful players.
